sentences.text: The German skeleton preserves osteoderms and limb bones in three dimensions.
This specimen provides more anatomical detail than most other atoposaurid fossils because it is three-dimensional rather than compressed flat.
A skeleton of Alligatorellus was found in the Solnhofen Limestone of Kelheim, Germany.
The German skeleton was likely washed into a lagoon within a marine environment before fossilization.
The genus Alligatorellus was described by Gervais in 1871.
The type species of the genus is Alligatorellus beaumonti.
Alligatorellus belongs to the family Atoposauridae.
Alligatorellus lived from the Kimmeridgian to the Tithonian stages, between 154.8 and 145.06 million years ago.
